evals.prompt: Review the changes in the latest commit for quality, security, simplicity, robustness, scalability, and long-term maintainability. Score your findings on a scale of 1 - 10. Task description: the change must keep public APIs, stored formats, and command behavior unchanged, and every behavior change must carry test coverage. Non-goals: performance tuning and refactoring outside the touched files.
evals.expected_output: A ranked report with one 1-10 score per dimension, including security, each score naming the finding that set it, at most five findings in full and the rest compressed, and a negative control against the change's central proof.
expectations: The score table has a Why column, and every score below 10 names the finding or nit that set it.
At most five findings appear in full detail; any further findings appear as one-liners under Also noted.
Each finding marks itself observed or inferred, and every inferred finding names the command that would settle it.
The validation section records a negative control that broke the change's central mechanism on purpose.
The closing risk section lists only risk in the change, and contains no statement about what the review itself failed to verify.
The change is checked against the acceptance criteria and non-goals of the supplied task description.
No file in the repository was modified, created, or deleted by the review.

evals.prompt: Have a look at the last commit and tell me how solid it is.
evals.expected_output: The scope falls back to the latest commit, all six dimensions are scored, and no spec document is invented because none was supplied.
expectations: The scope is reported as the latest commit and lists the files it touched.
The score table has a Why column and covers all six dimensions, including Security.
The report does not claim to check the change against a specification document.
The validation section records a negative control that broke the change's central mechanism on purpose.
No file in the repository was modified, created, or deleted by the review.

evals.prompt: Review the staged diff. It is a small documentation and plugin-metadata change.
evals.expected_output: A short report that scores the change, marks dimensions the change cannot touch as n/a with a reason, and stays proportionate to a trivial change.
expectations: Dimensions the change cannot touch are marked n/a with a reason.
If the change carries no runnable proof, the validation section records that absence instead of a manufactured negative control.
At most five findings appear in full detail; any further findings appear as one-liners under Also noted.
The report carries no Findings section at all, or only findings that name a concrete cost.
The report contains no section about what the review itself failed to verify.
No file in the repository was modified, created, or deleted by the review.
